summary: Completed comprehensive E2E testing of RRL Builders Post-Sales CRM. All critical features tested: Login, Dashboard, Leads Management, Public Booking Form, Price Calculator, Customer Detail Page, Document Generation. Backend 28/28 tests passed (100%). Frontend UI fully functional.

minor.issue: Returns empty list instead of {units: [], total: 0} object when no units exist. Inconsistent response format.

critical_code_review_comments: SendGrid email integration is MOCKED - logs to communication_logs collection but does not send real emails
WhatsApp integration is also MOCKED - no real messages sent
seed_data_creation: API tests created multiple TEST_ prefixed customers for testing CRUD, leads, documents, and payment schedule features
context_for_next_testing_agent: All APIs and UI flows are working correctly. The public booking form at /booking-form creates leads with stage='pending_approval'. The send welcome email feature is MOCKED and stores records in communication_logs. Price Calculator correctly calculates using formula: (Rate × Saleable Area) + Club House (₹2L) + Additional Parking (₹3L each) + Labour Cess (0.70%) + GST (5%).
